name: Recall Memory
description: Read a caller-scoped memory collection and render its current surfaceable entries as a stable numbered text block. Returns null when empty. This read-only operation is suitable for watched agent context; use the memory tool to edit the list.

displayField.description: For a map of records, the field shown as each line (default 'text').

noteField.description: Optional record field appended after each line as a note.

output.description: A numbered text block, or null when no entries are surfaceable.
